title: Renewal Loyalty Program Terms: Tenure Share on the Final Water Overage Charge
content:
# Final-Overage Tenure Share — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package Water

**Term.** A final-overage tenure share applies to the final water overage line of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account:

1. **0.80** when the Apartment Home Lease's move-in date lies at least 36 whole months before the service end date;
2. **0.90** when it lies at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months before it;
3. the **whole charge** otherwise.

The share multiplies the line's charge, which is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Tenure bands with boundary dates (hypothetical service end date 2026-09-30)

| Move-in date | Whole months to the service end date | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 2023-09-30 | 36 | 0.80 |
| 2023-10-01 | 35 | 0.90 |
| 2025-09-30 | 12 | 0.90 |
| 2025-10-01 | 11 | whole |

*Worked case (hypothetical charge of $31.50):* 0.80 gives $25.20; 0.90 gives $28.35.
